div.span:
Dashed lines (- - -):
Represent the internal relationship between the
database and the model storage:
• PostgreSQL contains the soft_sensors table
• The table stores artifact_path (path to binary on disk)
• Through that path, the Directory of Models is accessed
• The directory returns the binary (.joblib, .pkl, .rds, .h5)
Metadata is no longer stored in YAML files — all model
information is in the DB as JSONB.
